replay.eof_policy: no timer advance beyond last recorded receipt
replay.imu: diagnostic messages only; zero independent IMU factors

optimizer.initialization: previous accepted active estimates plus Odom prediction

marginalization.linearization_point: last maintained active estimates before solving the new update
marginalization.prior_chart: world XY and wrapped yaw delta
marginalization.historical_nonlinearity: frozen linearized Gaussian approximation; not exact batch relinearization

frontend.output_history: external sink; estimator retains last valid publication only

evaluation_only.position_update_metric: distance from previous publication propagated by Odom to current publication; separate first graph initialization correction

assumptions: Start antenna position and +Y heading are user-confirmed external inputs.
The measured approximate geometric center is conditionally treated as the Odom body reference; unverified.
Installation-specific anchors, P1 correction and weights are frozen before these dynamic tests.
Both recordings are development data, not an unseen benchmark.
The one-second deadline delay supports inherited centered bins; it is not measured network latency.
The estimator working set is bounded for the 20 s arm; offline reader diagnostics and archived outputs grow with recording length.
State/sample counts and max_nfev bound numerical work but do not provide a hard wall-clock deadline guarantee.
IMU factors, hardware, ROS transport, and model calibration are unchanged.
